{{Quote|Commander Qrukk is an intelligence officer and Darth Xarion's faithful servant. Qrukk is here to see his lord's orders fulfilled.|Qrukk|<ref name="TOR:VT" />}}
'''Qrukk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Breather Gand|Breather]] [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] who was a [[Sith Intelligence]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Third Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], where he participated in the [[Invasion of Manaan]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Qrukk has analyzed the data of the previous operation and formulated a far superior strategy. A deliberate and calculated design. For the Empire to finally achieve victory on this world, we must follow a new path. One that the Selkath cannot see, and therefore, cannot stop.|Qrukk|<ref name="TOR:VT" />}}
Qrukk was originally a member of the Imperial-aligned mercenary unit known as [[Krallet Division]], where he served under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jilo Del]], whom he was constantly at odds with. While Del was indiscriminate in his slaughter of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] and civilians, Qrukk preferred purpose and tasks that strengthened the Empire. At one point, Qrukk plotted to oust Del and succeed him as leader of Krallet Division, but he was betrayed by an undercover subordinate who hoped for a promotion by revealing Qrukk’s intents to her master, [[Dark Council]]or [[Darth Xarion]] of the [[Sphere of Galactic Influence]]. However, Xarion was impressed by Qrukk’s restraint, patience, and skill, and offered him the position of commander of the [[Imperial Infiltration Specialists]], charging him with overseeing the Imperial invasion of [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] from the shadows. Recognizing this offer as his chance to achieve his long-desired purpose, Qrukk enthusiastically accepted.<ref name="Qrukk" />

==Behind the scenes==
Commander Qrukk appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith|Legacy of the Sith]]'' expansion of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as the contact for the Imperial bonus series on Manaan.<ref name="TOR:VT" />
